# Notes

The body cites a claim.[^1] It links [the body target](https://body.example/) and cites again.[^2]

An endnote comes next[^3], then the first footnote again[^1].

A dangling reference disappears: before, after.

A reference hard against a parenthesis[^4]\(like this).

[^5]\: a reference opening its line.

[^1]: The first note, whose link [goes to the notes target](https://notes.example/).

    Its second paragraph.

    - a list item in a note
    - another

[^2]: The second note holds a picture ![A small picture](footnotes_media/image1.png) and cites an endnote.[^6]

[^3]: The endnote.

[^4]: A note with a table:

    | a | b |
    | --- | --- |
    | 1 | 2 |

[^5]:

[^6]: An endnote cited from a footnote.
